exposure: Individualized lifestyle intervention (dietary counselling and moderate-intensity physical activity)
cohort: 293 pregnant women aged 18 or older, less than 20 gestational weeks, and with a history of GDM or pre-pregnancy BMI ≥ 30 kg/m².
finding: An individualized lifestyle intervention reduced the incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus and maternal weight gain in high-risk pregnant women compared to a control group receiving standard information.
mod_finding: The intervention did not significantly affect the rate of cesarean sections.
